name: D6 small-subset memorization/capacity audit
purpose: distinguish inadequate architecture/objective from held-out data generalization
scope: diagnostic only; cannot authorize DEV, TEST, or deployment

data.selection: first state from each of the first eight numerically sorted remaining episodes
data.nested_selection: first deterministic group from each selected episode
data.evaluation: the exact same selected examples used for optimization

optimization.probe_use: all 64 with independently randomized order per selected state

capacity_gate_per_arm.response_spread: median predicted/physical ratio in every phase between 0.5 and 1.5

interpretation.any_arm_passes: mapping is representable; held-out failure primarily implicates data diversity/generalization
interpretation.neither_arm_passes: current output parameterization/objective/optimization is inadequate before data collection
interpretation.set_only: joint neighborhood context is necessary and representable
